item.description:
📢 Our services:
✅  One year warranty, if any quality problems occur within one year, a new machine will be replaced free of charge.
✅  After sales service center, lifelong consulting service
✅  Free remote installation, one-on-one assistance and guidance.
✅  Free label editing software for PC and mobile phones
✅ Order before 4 o'clock and ship on the same day

📢 Smart Life
For mobile editing software, please directly search for "Phomemo" App to download.
✅ Free barcode and product label design program, enjoy automatic template matching, customized label design, image recognition, batch printing and other functions
✅ Free installation service and basic usage guidance.
💻 Windows / Mac
Windows and Macbook will automatically install drivers, and we provide a driver for you to load without the need for a CD.
✅ Note: Bluetooth connection on mobile phones can only be used through the "Phomemo" application.

📢 Applicable fields
1. Commercial office scenario: Contract documents/bills/emails/price menus/product labels/repair lists/shipping documents
2. Family scenario: study notes/homework/travel guide/pictures/storage classification tags/graffiti painting/ledger decoration

📢 new version
The volume and weight are only half of traditional printers. Machine size: 325*67*40 millimeters. Weight: 0.75 kilograms (including battery). By purchasing the model now, you will receive a roll of label paper (built-in in the printer) as a gift.

📢 New ways to save money
Using thermal printing, only replace the label paper after use, no need to purchase ink, toner or copy paper again! No need to purchase batteries, saving up to 70% of printing costs!

Product Details
Brand: Phomemo
Weight: 0.75 kilograms
Size: 325*67*40 millimeters (length * width * height)
Material: ABS+PC
Printer type: Thermal printer
Consumable type: Thermal paper
Maximum resolution: 203dpi
Printing speed: 15 mm/s
Printing size: 210 millimeters
Interface type: USB+Bluetooth
Model: M08D

What is inside the box?
1* M08D Thermal Printer
1* Usb Cable
1* Power Adapter
1* Quick Start Guide
1* 10pcs of Thermal paper
